summary: Frontend-only push notification regression pass completed. Expo web preview boots in mobile viewport without red-screen/runtime crash after expo-task-manager integration; push payload/deep-link and app config updates were validated by code review plus config resolution checks.

integration_issues.flow: Push response handling for data.type=call and data.type=message
integration_issues.issue: Could not execute end-to-end notification-tap deep-link navigation in this run (web preview + no authenticated/native push context). Validation is code-level only.

integration_issues.flow: Background task + token-listener behavior on web preview
integration_issues.issue: Console repeatedly logs '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' Needs verification that addPushTokenListener path is fully gated to native runtime only.

action_items: Run native device validation (Android + iOS) with authenticated sessions and real push payloads for call/message taps, action buttons, and background task execution.
Confirm web runtime never registers push-token listeners; if warning persists, tighten guards around token-listener registration paths.
Add a focused unit/integration test around normalizeNotificationPayload + handleResponse route mapping to prevent regressions in call/message deep-link parsing.
critical_code_review_comments: Device registration payload in usePushNotifications.ts matches requested schema exactly: { expoPushToken, platform, deviceName, appVersion } with backend fallback mutation path.
Deep-link handling logic is present for both notification types: type=call routes to /call/:conversationId (with displayName when available), type=message routes to /chat/:conversationId.

Potential functional risk: background dedupe key for messages uses type + conversationId/title, which may suppress multiple distinct message notifications from the same conversation while app is backgrounded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 31 confirms preview boot stability and config presence after expo-task-manager integration. Remaining high-value checks are native push E2E behaviors (tap actions, background task delivery, token refresh, channel behavior) which are not reproducible in signed-out web preview.
rca_of_issue: Observed warning suggests a web runtime path still touching push token listener APIs. Repro in this run: load root preview and observe repeated console warning from expo-notifications. Mitigation: verify all addPushTokenListener registration code executes only when Platform.OS !== 'web' and only after native notification subsystem setup. MOCKED APIs: NONE.
